JUPUS | Engineering Manager, Applied AI | REMOTE (CET ±2) | Full-time | Up to €160k base | https://jupus.de

JUPUS is an AI platform for German law firms, from client intake to drafted briefs. 2,000+ lawyers use it daily.

You'll own AI at JUPUS: the Applied AI team (5 direct reports), the technical roadmap and the quality bar. No delivery commitments. You make the architecture calls on retrieval, evaluation and agent design.

You've managed engineers with direct reports, and spent 3+ years at a company where agentic AI is central to the product.

85 people, €19.5M raised, fully remote.

Apply here: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/jupus/a40c4367-20c9-4afe-9b6c-bdc86... Please mention HN in your application if you saw the role here.
